scope: Normalize stat-only supporting-file fingerprints across canonical skill aliases. No host registration, native client, model, configuration, trust or installation operation.

original_evidence_retained.boundary: The earlier receipt's local source hashes describe the original content commit, not this repaired source. Its actual failed/passing attempts remain unchanged.

finding: A supporting file traversed through both shared and Claude alias roots could enter the stat fingerprint twice. Adding/removing only the alias could therefore emit a spurious content-change row.
repair: Share the resolved-directory visited set across all roots in each state group. Each supporting file contributes once, while alias path stamps still trigger an inexpensive rescan.

actual_test_result.new_oracle: Add then remove a Claude alias of a shared skill containing a supporting file. The actual canonical fingerprint and ledger row count must remain unchanged.

acceptance_boundary: Local filesystem/observer integration fixture only. Fresh-client firing, real add/remove, hook trust, live S4 integration, representative latency and model efficacy remain untested. Final registered-file validation is reported separately.
sanitization: Only compact actual results and log digests are public. No raw logs, personal host paths, hook payloads, instruction bodies or credentials are retained.
